moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers reached agreement on a three‑year, $165 million extension
moments.why: A major QB contract right before the season is huge news, especially for guys 25–45 tracking NFL front‑office drama.

moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Rams DT Aaron Donald won’t travel to Australia for season opener and will be INACTIVE
moments.why: Donald’s return from retirement was anticipated; his absence in Week 1 has immediate headlines among NFL fans.

moments.author: USTA / US Open official
moments.quote: Shelton prefers tank tops in humid matches – “the less fabric, the better”
moments.why: Ben Shelton’s candid comment on court attire in a high-stakes US Open match has gone viral among tennis and style‑mindful fans.

moments.quote: Tsitsipas’ coach messaged Ben Shelton immediately after his quarter‑final win
